test_weight_converter: test the WeightConverter class to merge, concatenate, and chunk weight tensors during model loading
test_weight_renaming: test the WeightRenaming class to rename source weight keys using glob pattern matching
test_convert_and_load_state_dict: test convert_and_load_state_dict_in_model to load and convert a state dict into a PyTorch model
test_revert_weight_conversion: test revert_weight_conversion to reverse weight conversions and recover the original state dict
test_rename_source_key: test rename_source_key to rewrite a single weight key using a list of WeightRenaming rules
test_conv3d_linear_conversion: test Conv3dToLinear and LinearToConv3d operations to convert between 3D conv and linear weight shapes
